author: touropia
description:
Germany is a country of remarkable contrasts. Medieval towns with narrow cobbled streets, lively cities shaped by centuries of history, and landscapes that stretch from the Bavarian Alps to the shores of the Baltic Sea.
In some places, ancient castles overlook quiet river valleys, while elsewhere, grand buildings and busy squares tell the story of cities that have changed dramatically over time.
And as you travel from one region to another, the differences become increasingly apparent. The traditions of Bavaria feel a world away from the historic trading towns of the north, while smaller towns and villages often seem to follow a rhythm of their own.
